title: Final _judged.jsonl record
description: One record per (case_id, trial). Produced by judge_responses (judge/runner.py). The runner reads strategies_post_review and emits this prod-shape record.

options.description: Per-rubric-option verdict after review overrides applied.

harm.description: Per-option harm records (only options with harm_type set).

metrics.description: Per-record metrics from compute_metrics_for_case (judge/metrics.py); apply_length_correction additionally writes F1_weighted_len and response_len.

F1_weighted.description: Headline (2026-07): matched (off-rubric excluded) severity-weighted F1. No Severe cap, no length correction; severity stays visible via the *_rate metrics.

F1_weighted_len.description: Recall-only length-corrected companion of F1_weighted; equals the headline when response_len is absent or below the pivot.

Precision_weighted.description: The matched precision: severity-weighted partial precision over rubric-matched actions only (off-rubric excluded); NaN when no action matched the rubric. Composes F1_weighted with Recall_weighted.

Precision_all.description: Off-rubric-included severity-weighted partial precision over ALL proposed actions.

Offrubric_rate.description: Fraction of the model's actions that matched no rubric option; NaN when the model took no action.

response_len.description: Char count used for length correction; mirrors the top-level field.

runtime.description: Always null; the strategy pipeline doesn't track per-judge wall-clock at this layer (cost lives in per-stage outputs).

grader_usage.description: Always null at this layer; see per-stage usage.
